blocks.title: What the system did
blocks.text:
Planner `rules` routed this request to the intents docking, rank_candidates.

- `S1` **target_analyst** -> resolve_target — every downstream claim needs a verified target identity
- `S2` **chemistry_retriever** -> known_actives — ground design in measured actives, not in LLM memory
- `S3` **docking_agent** -> dock — structure-based score, validated by redocking on the same receptor
- `S4` **structure_analyst** -> analyse_structure — binding-site detection on the selected structure
- `S5` **ranker** -> rank_and_select — multi-objective Pareto ranking + diversity-aware portfolio
- `S6` **critic** -> cross_check — independent recomputation and applicability-domain audit

Tools actually invoked: `chembl.activities`, `chembl.status`, `chembl.target_by_accession`, `docking.box_from_ligand_pdb`, `docking.pose_rmsd_all_models`, `docking.prepare_ligand`, `docking.prepare_receptor`, `docking.vina_dock`, `docking.vina_version`, `pdb.chain_sequences`, `pdb.chemcomp`, `pdb.download`, `pdb.entry`, `pdb.extract_ligand`, `pdb.extract_receptor`, `pdb.ligands`, `pocket.detect`, `rdkit.scaffold`, `uniprot.entry`, `uniprot.search_gene`, `uniprot.sequence_features`.
